name: mirage
text: Understood: the Bids tab becomes the control center for the GitHub engine's bids. Off, Recommend and Automatic all work on the engine as you described; every Bids setting and the slider are sent to the engine; the changes are batched into one write 15 seconds after your last change, and the engine uses them immediately. Plan: audit every control on the tab, make Recommend work on the engine with a Post button that sends a one-time post request, and the 15-second batched send. The first piece is out now as v1.0.62: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.62 It shows the engine's real resting bids and fills, and Off or Recommend now stop the engine from posting. The rest follows as one release.
